The cleanest shape we make. A band collar, one zip straight down the front, and nothing else asking for attention — the Rebel is the jacket you reach for without thinking, and it looks better in year three than year one.

The details

  • Band collar
  • Straight centre front zip
  • Four outer pockets — two chest, two side
  • Zip cuffs
  • Two inside pockets
  • Quilted viscose lining
  • Premium top-grain sheep leather

Made to order

Every Kordovan jacket is cut and stitched after you order, in our own workshop. Allow about 3 weeks from checkout to your door — winter is our busiest season and the bench is full, so we would rather quote you honestly than promise a date we can't hold. Payment is taken in full online at checkout — credit card, debit card or JazzCash. Cash on delivery isn't offered on made-to-order pieces, because each jacket is cut to your size and can't go back on a shelf.

Sizing

The size chart is in the image gallery. Between sizes, or want it built to your own measurements? Send us your chest, shoulder and sleeve on WhatsApp and we will make it to fit.

Prefer cow leather?

Every jacket here is premium top-grain sheep leather — supple, light, and it softens to your shape. We can also make any of them in cow hide, which is heavier and firmer. It is priced separately, so message us on WhatsApp for a quote.

Not a jacket so much as a coat. The Hawkeye runs to mid-thigh, closes double-breasted under a wide notch lapel, and pulls in at a self-leather belt — the kind of outerwear that reads as deliberate rather than thrown on. The antiqued finish is uneven by design: bright on the shoulders, dark in every crease.

Cash on delivery isn't offered on made-to-order pieces, because each jacket is cut to your size and can't go back on a shelf.

Sizing

The size chart is in the image gallery. Between sizes, or want it built to your own measurements? Send us your chest, shoulder and sleeve on WhatsApp and we will make it to fit.

Prefer cow leather?

Every jacket here is premium top-grain sheep leather — supple, light, and it softens to your shape. We can also make any of them in cow hide, which is heavier and firmer. It is priced separately, so message us on WhatsApp for a quote.
